read.thesis: Clean quarter with adjusted EPS up 20% and ROE at 17%, but supply-side read is neutral for an insurer; spread (97bp vs 100-120 guide) and PE returns (0.8%) were the soft spots, and PRT stays lumpy.

triggers.label: Total spread 97bp, below 100-120bp guide
triggers.quote: Total investment spread was 97 basis points in the second quarter, below our guidance range of 100 to 120 basis points

triggers.label: Group Life mortality ratio 79%
triggers.quote: The Group Life mortality ratio was 79%, reflecting continued improvement in mortality among the working age population.

triggers.label: Latin America record quarterly earnings $268M
triggers.quote: adjusted earnings of $268 million represented a quarterly record

triggers.label: Asia sales +17% constant currency
triggers.quote: Sales advanced 17% on a constant currency basis

guidance.quote: we're pretty confident that we're going to be within our retained balance growth of 3% to 5% for the full year
though likely toward the low end
we remain confident in our ability to beat our 2026 target of 12.1%

guidance.value: Core spread 95 to 100bp baseline; Q3 near midpoint
